candidates.requirement: Initialize the notes obstack before the fuzz entry creates assembler sections.
candidates.target_route: LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput calls read_begin and then perform_an_assembly_pass. The pass creates .text through subseg_new, which reaches alloc_seginfo and obstack_alloc(&notes).
candidates.failure_condition: Initialization was moved from read_begin to main, which the fuzz entry does not call. Section metadata allocation therefore uses an uninitialized notes obstack before input parsing.
candidates.alternative_paths: subsegs_begin initializes section chains, not notes; read_begin no longer initializes notes. The target calls neither main nor another shown notes initializer before the pass.
